method: Read supplied original pages, operations, ordered result units and objective questions only; decode aliases and originalTextIndex losslessly. No model predictions, external source contents, live pages or provider calls were inspected.
scopeLimits: Only four selected proposed centralize operations, not a representative sample of all runs or operation kinds.
Each request asks only objective. A successful objective judgement alone cannot authorize applying an operation or prove unasked integrity gates.
Integrity assessments concern changed claims and their supplied page context/source inventories, not independent verification of underlying real-world facts.
Single independent reviewer; medium-confidence and unknown labels require adjudication before being treated as hard benchmark gold.
Rendered link behavior and live destination existence were not tested.
